name: Mala's Mixberry Jam
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Mixed Berries Pulp (45%) (Strawberry, Blueberry, Mulberry), Water, Thickener (INS 440), Acidity Regulator (INS 296, INS 300, INS 330). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MIXBERRY). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR (INS 122,INS 133). CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE (INS 202, INS 211)
